\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-94},
  title = {CD deploys through a runner on the VM that may only run \texorpdfstring{\texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh}}{deploy.sh}},
  date = {2026-10-30},
  milestone = {M5: Model Packaging},
  topic = {CI/CD, Deployment, Security},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/198}{issue \#198})},
  decision = {A self-hosted runner on the VM, as a user outside the \texttt{docker} group, runs the deploy and rollback jobs; sudo lets it run \texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh} with its three commands and nothing else.
The smoke check runs on a GitHub-hosted runner against the public URL.
The deploy job hands its own token to \texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}sh} on standard input for one GHCR pull.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item SSH from a GitHub-hosted runner: the VM's SSH port answers only from the UPC network.
\item The smoke check on the VM runner too: needs the repository and Python on a 1-core VM and gives no outside view.
\item The VM pulling on a timer: no deployment record, no gate, no rollback after a failed smoke check.
\item A personal token in the VM's Docker configuration: a lasting credential on a shared VM.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} From outside the UPC network, SSH to the VM timed out while its HTTP port answered (\#134), so only an outbound connection from the VM works.
No repository code runs on the runner; a fork pull request's workflows run only after a team member approved them, and a test keeps every other workflow on \texttt{main} off the runner.
In an Ubuntu 20.04 container, the VM's release, sudo 1.8.31 refused every other command tried.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out the options for reaching the VM and for the private package and recommended the chosen ones; @lukas2510 decided both as recommended.
AI then wrote the workflow, the install script and the guard test, and probed the sudoers rule in the container.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-30 on deploying to the VM, prompt ``please continue with it, look at the VM'' (translated from German); the AI's question ``How should CD reach the VM?'' was answered with its recommended option.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/134}{Issue \#134's result}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/198}{issue \#198}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/237}{PR \#237}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml}{\texttt{deploy.\allowbreak{}yml}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/deployment.md\#turn-continuous-deployment-on}{deployment docs}.},
}
